basis: A hereditary bipolar affective disorder; purely psychiatric disease has no axis.
Transient neonatal thyroid hormone deficiency; permanent neurologic injury is not intrinsic to this transient subtype.
Lysosomal lipid storage disease with defining childhood neurodegeneration; functional hepatic damage is not established at >=30% in this onset subgroup.
An ocular glaucoma-spectrum diagnosis; no additional organ involvement is intrinsic.
Neurodevelopmental disease with intellectual disability in 8/8 and spasticity in 7/8; individual skeletal, cardiac and thyroid abnormalities occur below 30%.
Adenocarcinoma arising in the urinary bladder; hepatoid differentiation does not establish liver involvement.
Mitochondrial metabolic disease defined by skeletal myopathy, lactic acidosis and cognitive impairment.
Autoinflammatory syndrome defined by inflammatory arthritis and destructive inflammatory skin disease.
Lethal skeletal dysplasia with defective sterol biosynthesis; leukocyte morphology alone is non-damaging; functional airway damage frequency is uncertain.
Umbrella of spirochetal bacterial infections; no specific damaged organ is common across the group.
Motor neuron degeneration and dementia define neurologic disease; ophthalmoplegia is a defining loss of ocular movement.
Inherited marrow failure with deficient blood-cell production; extrahematologic abnormalities vary across subtypes.
Complement-system immunodeficiency; infections and autoimmune complications do not establish common direct organ damage across this umbrella.
Congenital skeletal malformation comprising triphalangeal thumbs and duplicated distal thumb phalanges.
Primary breast carcinoma; breast has no axis, and distant organ involvement is not intrinsic.
Defining intellectual disability and seizures, optic atrophy in 80-99%, and hearing loss in 20/20; joint contractures occur below 30%.
Benign smooth-muscle tumour arising in the rectum; visceral smooth muscle does not imply skeletal muscle disease.
Acquired FX-related bleeding disorder; the supplied definition describes common circulating FX inhibitors, supporting an immune mechanism.
Inherited insulin excess causing hypoglycemia; permanent hypoglycemic brain injury is variable and not established at >=30% across this umbrella.
Defining limb contractures, oral clefts and skin/nail abnormalities; ankyloblepharon causes structural eyelid dysfunction in 30-79%.
Congenital fibroblastic tumour arising in the kidney.
Defined as a psychiatric elimination disorder without an underlying medical condition; urinary incontinence alone does not establish urinary-organ damage.
Defined by severe neurodevelopmental disease, retinal dystrophy and diabetes insipidus with purine metabolic disease; sensorineural hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%.
Diffuse subcutaneous adipose overgrowth; steroid exposure or hormonal association does not itself establish an endocrine gland disorder.
Disease of peripheral arteries or veins; downstream tissue injury is not universal across this vascular umbrella.
